messages:
Nora Kim: Quick thread 10m: partners asked for a compact IaC "starter pack" for marketplace onboarding. Must be reproducible, runnable in under 30m, and include AWS + GCP flavors. Keep everything tiny and opinionated. Who can take which pieces?
Ethan Morales: I can pick up AWS. Plan: modules/aws/core (VPC, subnet, LB, launch template) + modules/aws/pack (packer sample + AMI checklist). Will support Graviton instance types via var `cpu_arch = "x86_64" | "arm64"`.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll own GCP. modules/gcp/core (network, subnetwork, instance-template, mig) + examples/cloudbuild.yaml and a startup-script that installs nginx. Will document image-family usage for marketplace.
Raj Patel: I'll do repo scaffolding and marketplace manifest template. I'll add `examples/marketplace/README.marketplace.md` with exact reviewer steps and expected outputs (lb_dns, image_used, instance_count).
Nora Kim: Nice. Packaging notes from partners: include a one-page reviewer checklist (CIS highlights + minimal IAM), a LICENSE file, and a sample pricing/metadata JSON. Keep reviewer checklist < 300 words.
Ethan Morales: Implementation note: for AWS module accept `ami_id` OR `ami_lookup` with filters. Example variable: `ami_source = "ami_id" | "lookup" | "pipeline"`. Will include small `scripts/verify_ami.sh` that runs SSH health check.
Sofia Alvarez: For GCP, include a `startup-script.sh` and expose an output `image_family_used`. Will include cloudbuild sample that builds the image and publishes to a temp family.
Raj Patel: CI: add a lightweight matrix job that runs `terraform validate` + `tflint` + `tfsec` and a smoke job that runs examples against sandbox projects/accounts. packaging-bot: CI tip: add a short `preflight.sh` that checks LICENSE, README.marketplace.md, and presence of `compliance-checklist.md`.
Nora Kim: Action items and owners: Ethan = aws modules + AMI checklist + packer example; Sofia = gcp modules + cloudbuild + startup script; Raj = repo skeleton + manifest template + CI pipeline; Nora = coordinate legal sign-off and run the final preflight. Deadline: next Thu EOD.
Ethan Morales: I'll post PR link when AWS prototype is up. Expect a small PR by Tue.
Sofia Alvarez: GCP prototype by Wed.
Raj Patel: Repo skeleton pushed (private repo). Will share link in-thread and add issue templates for reviewers. packaging-bot: Reminder: marketplace uploads commonly need pricing metadata and a 3-5 day review window.
Nora Kim: Thanks team 10x. If any policy blockers surface ping me and Legal. Drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
